shortcut_name: XOR of keys 1 and 2 reveals bipartite coloring
evidence: The solution alternates colors with `nxt = color[v] ^ 1`, which directly corresponds to recognizing that `1 XOR 2 = 3` and therefore every edge must connect opposite assignments.
affordance_in_statement: each relay must be assigned a base encryption key of either 1 or 2; the bitwise XOR of the encryption keys assigned to the two connected relays must evaluate to exactly 3
removal_suggestion: This is the core structure of the task: the XOR condition on the two allowed values is exactly the constraint that adjacent vertices receive different values. It cannot be removed by rewording without obscuring or changing the problem itself.
